text:
Victor Olofsson has played only six games for Vegas, and he's scored in most of them. He had four goals in the season's first week, then missed nearly a month with an injury, and came back with an assist in Detroit on November 5. Six points in six games is a great start for a player on his second stint in Vegas, his fourth stop since leaving Buffalo.

It won't stay at this pace. He's shooting 28.6% against a league norm of about 13%, and his career line says he's a 20-goal type when healthy, not a 50-goal type. Vegas has controlled 70% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on the ice, but six games is a sample you can wave away. Evolving-Hockey had him around replacement level last season, with very strong linemates flattering his on-ice numbers.

What's real is the shot. When he gets power-play time, he scores, and two of his six points have come there. Our range has him around 19 goals by April if he stays healthy, and that's the biggest if for him.
headline: Victor Olofsson picked up where he left off
